verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a REST API authenticated with API keys, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are related features, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
